proposal.rationale: The asset's current profile (tls13-hybrid-x25519-mlkem768) cannot be re-proposed per task rules. The only other allowlisted profile meeting the security_floor (hybrid-pqc or higher) is tls13-mlkem768 (pqc class); tls13-x25519 is classical and falls below the floor, so it is disqualified regardless of endpoint count. For tls13-mlkem768, only peer-02 is both 'known' and advertises the required kem:mlkem768 capability among peers eligible for this batch; peer-03 also qualifies technically but is explicitly flagged for decommissioning and excluded per the inventory note. peer-01, peer-04, and peer-05 lack the mlkem768 capability. This yields a 1-endpoint batch on the highest permissible security class available (pqc), satisfying the objective of maximizing ready endpoints among floor-compliant profiles while preferring higher security class. Recommend executing within the designated Tuesday 02:00-04:00 UTC change window with 30-minute post-change handshake error monitoring per the change note, and revisiting peer-03 inclusion only if its decommissioning is cancelled/delayed.
